text_block_list.text:
Eccentric as her methods are, T.M. Opera's
dedication to her dream is
truer than any.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's not easy to find that kind of
motivation, so I decide to have
another
talk with her about training. As I'm
scouring the school to find
her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you glorious sun! Let us shine our light
upon the world!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She strives to gain the sun-like light of the
Overlord, believing her
conviction will
carry her forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My brilliance shines bright as ever!
Hahahaha! Haaah ha ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And with that, she turns and runs off to
continue her theatrics
elsewhere.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I can't help but notice the energy in each of her steps. Thinking back, her training was more impressive than I gave her credit for...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ah! I dance as beautifully as a swan!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Without perfectly balanced form, she
could never have kept up those
nimble
dance moves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hark! What dances through the skies with
the grace of a swallow? 'Tis
I!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Even her diving at the pool required a
strong mental fortitude.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
May my beauty fill the whole world with
happiness!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And her power and speed climbing those
stairs to the shrine were a
true testament
to her abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She isn't just saying she wants to be
Overlord. She wants all the skill
and ability
that the title requires.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Maybe... she really is on the track to glory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I had the strangest sensation that someone
called my name. Must've
been a fancy of
my imagination...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She's too far away to notice my futile
attempts to call her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just have to get really loud... I'll
call her in a voice suitable to
summoning
the Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Haha... Haaaah ha ha ha HAH!

text_block_list.text: That voice!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What fortune is this?! If it isn't my former
provisional trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That laugh just now was as magisterial as a
true Overlord... What
brought about this
change in you?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
I want to become a trainer magisterial enough
to work with you.

text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, world?! This fine trainer
wishes to work with me
once again!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Such a majestic bellow of laughter was for
me?! Of course it was...
Hehe, hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha ha hah! What fun this is
turning out to be, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But be not mistaken! For us to become a
real team, we must share in
the same
aspirations.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So I would hear it from your lips! Tell me
true, what is the absolute
meaning in
"Overlord" that I seek?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
To seize your dream, through overwhelming
victory!

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Superb! Most excellent—positively
perfect, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The overwhelming power of the Overlord
imparts bravery to the
masses! The
Overlord becomes the hope that people
live for!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I will settle for no
mere first-place win—I will
obtain absolute
victory and become the Centurial
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Have you steeled your heart to combine
forces and achieve
immortality?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
Making you Centurial Overlord will be my life's
mission!

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha ha hah! Well said,
Trainer! A new legend begins
on this day!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Though, such a stupendous event must be
fittingly celebrated. How
best to cement
this in history... I know! Let's take a selfie!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You together with me, the Overlord—this
"usie" shall be glorious.
Now let your joy
shine forth!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Later, Opera O sends me the pictures we
took that day, which are
mostly of her
alone...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless... With that, the curtains rose
over our regal road to
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
